title: feat: add Monochrome Accent style + enhanced gallery search
head: feat/aniverse-trending-styles-and-search
body:
## What

Added a new Monochrome Accent style preset and enhanced the gallery search, based on A1 Market Research insights.

### Changes

1. New Style Preset - Monochrome Accent (src/lib/constants.ts)
   - Added to STYLE_PRESETS and TRENDING_STYLES showcase
   - Gradient: from-slate-600 to-zinc-800

2. New Pollinations.ai Prompt Prefix (src/app/dashboard/create/page.tsx)
   - Added monochrome grayscale prompt prefix

3. Enhanced Gallery Search (src/app/dashboard/gallery/page.tsx)
   - Search now also matches descriptions and style names

## Why

From A1 Market Research (2026-07-27):
- Monochrome with Accent Color identified as emerging trend
- Semantic Search identified as Priority 4

## How to Test

1. Go to /dashboard/create and verify Monochrome Accent appears
2. Select it and generate artwork
3. Go to /dashboard/gallery and search by description keywords

## Environment Variables

None.
